rule.name: HeadCutErrorOutput
rule.message: This keeps only the start of the output of a tool or of a stack trace and puts it into an exception or an error log. Build tools, compilers, test runners and stack traces print the cause at the end (the failing task, the last "Caused by:", the summary), so the message keeps the banner and drops the reason. Keep the end (output.substring(Math.max(0, output.length() - 4000))), or the start and the end with a marker between them.
